title: Universal localizations invert precisely the degenerate-image edge collection
statement: Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, equivalence edges and coherent functor categories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and universal localization of [def-coef-universally-localizing-simplicial-map]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a universally localizing simplicial map. Put $W_f=\{w\in A_1\mid f(w)=s_0(b)\text{ for some }b\in B_0\}$. Then, for every quasicategory $\mathcal E$ in a sufficiently large universe, restriction along $f$ induces a coherent functor equivalence from $\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal E)$ onto the full subcategory of $\operatorname{Fun}(A,\mathcal E)$ on diagrams carrying all edges of $W_f$ to equivalences. No quasicategory, Kan, finiteness or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed on $A$ or $B$.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.5.5 (02M2), consequence of Proposition 6.3.5.4 (02M1), with the functor-category characterization in Proposition 6.3.1.13 (01MS). These are Kerodon tags, not Stacks tags; no Stacks tag states this coherent theorem. Read online 2026-10-17; archive WANTED.
